Duplicate contacts sitting in your CRM create real friction for your team.

When the same prospect fills out two different forms weeks apart, your team shouldn't have to manually spot the match and merge the records. Left unchecked, reps end up working out of conflicting notes or calling the same account twice.

Here is how the process changes when you automate deduplication:

→ Incoming submissions are checked against existing emails and phone numbers.
→ Matching records merge automatically while keeping all activity history.
→ Reps see one clean, unified timeline for every account.

Clean data doesn't happen by accident. It happens when your CRM is configured to catch duplicates at the door.
